title: Threat-intel consensus pack (P171, CR27-CR30)
notes: Names the CR27-CR30 rules read; modules that report them use exactly these meanings. The rules only read the graph.

attributes.jarm: JARM TLS fingerprint (62 hex characters) of a TLS service of the host, from indexed scan data (a string, a list, or {port, jarm} items); a live JARM probe is ACTIVE and runs only on in-scope authorized targets (CR30)
attributes.jarm_c2_matches: list of {jarm, family, list, source}: known command-and-control fingerprints a source matched against the host's indexed JARM (CR30 needs an extra signal)
attributes.scanner_classification: classification of an internet-scanner address by a scanner-intelligence source (e.g. GreyNoise): benign | malicious | unknown; 'benign' (research/search-engine scanners) downgrades CR27 consensus, never deletes it
